# Eight bills, one line each, so that one edit can be made to each field.
#
# The mirror of invoice_lines_before_an_edit.txt, and the same question: a
# field left out of the comparison that answers "does the book already say
# this?" is a field a person can edit in the ledger, import, and see reported
# `unchanged`.
#
# Two of these were left out. The bill comparison skipped `taxable:` and
# `tax_included:` on the reasoning that GnuCash could not persist a bill
# entry's tax flags — which was true of a vendor bill handled as a customer
# invoice, and is not true of one handled as a bill (CLAUDE.md §8). Both are
# written on import and both are read back, so both have to be compared.
#
# bill_lines_before_an_edit.txt is this file before the edits.
#
# What this fixture produces: the same bills, each with one field of its line
# changed.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_edited_bill_line_lands.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses
  type: Expense
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
  type: Expense
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Travel
  type: Expense
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
  type: Liability
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:GST
  type: Liability
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
  type: Accounts Payable
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

vendor "V-EDIT"
  name: "Edited Vendor"
  currency: CAD

taxtable "GST"
  entry:
    account: "Liabilities:GST"
    rate: 5.0%
    type: PERCENT

taxtable "PST"
  entry:
    account: "Liabilities:GST"
    rate: 8.0%
    type: PERCENT

bill "BILL-DATE"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-08
    description: "A line"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: true
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "GST"

bill "BILL-DESC"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A different line"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: true
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "GST"

bill "BILL-ACCOUNT"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Expenses:Travel"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: true
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "GST"

bill "BILL-QUANTITY"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 3
    price: 100
    taxable: true
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "GST"

bill "BILL-PRICE"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 125
    taxable: true
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "GST"

bill "BILL-TAXABLE"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "GST"

bill "BILL-INCLUDED"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: true
    tax_included: true
    tax_table: "GST"

bill "BILL-TABLE"
  vendor_id: "V-EDIT"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: true
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "PST"
